definition: the project's step-chain flow config — DATA, not code (requirements-spec AC-3, flow-control-spec v6 §7, core-design §6). chains maps a WORK TYPE to its chain ENTRIES; a task's contract.workType selects it, 'default' applies otherwise; an EMPTY chain = the task runs the lifecycle only (execution tasks — the runner does the work, outcomes arrive as observed evidence commits). A task's contract.flow overrides all. v3: an entry is {id, inputs?: {role → source}, params?, at?: 'grill'|'confirm'|'execute', verdict?: {decision → {gate, feedback?}}, when?} — the GATE SOURCE is data, the gate set and positions are not. A bare string id is the short form of {id}. The engine reads this file and never overrides it; the builtin fallback is the EMPTY chain.
template: idea → idea-validate → envision → detailed specs → continue (beginning build / planning); execution tasks run the lifecycle (work-type chains)
